worst_moment: "You wrote d = 360 m, but that's not right—check your units again." - the student had just fixed it to 100 m and said they were writing it, so this misreads the page and contradicts the previous turn.
best_moment: "72 km is 72,000 meters, and 1 hour is 3,600 seconds, so divide 72,000 by 3,600. What do you get?" - it teaches the conversion from first principles and leaves the arithmetic to the student.
